title: Hung flusher processes are never killed — isinstance guard is always false
description: isinstance(process, multiprocessing.Process) is always false for SpawnProcess objects, so process.kill() never executes. On hang paths, processes aren't killed and new ones spawn for the same shards, causing duplicate segment production and accumulation of orphan flushers with Redis connection leaks.

title: Dead method with no callers and misleading comments
description: _create_process_for_shard(self, shard) has no callers in src/ or tests/. Also dead guard at line 222 (if not process: continue), misleading per-shard comment at line 235, and restated comment at line 178.

title: Class docstring claims one process per shard; default is one for all shards
description: Docstring says 'Creates one process per shard' but --flusher-processes defaults to 1, making a single process handle all shards. Documentation contradicts the shipped default behavior.

title: The sleep added to test_basic is a no-op
description: time.sleep is patched to a lambda at line 15, so sleep(0.1) at line 62 returns immediately. Comment claims it gives flusher threads time to process, but the monkeypatch defeats this.
